propositions: get_issuelinks_map and get_comment_map use unpaginated search_issues calls with default max_results=50, silently truncating projects with more than 50 issues
projects with more than 50 issues lose issue links in the map and have incomplete comment sync without raising an error
search_issues callers throughout the codebase default to unpaginated max_results=50 instead of consuming a shared truncation-safe pager
the pager must advance by len(batch) returned and terminate only on empty page, not on short page, because Jira DC silently truncates maxResults below jira.search.views.default.max
get_parent_map previously had the same pagination bug and was patched in isolation, leaving two sibling methods with the same defect
